input.plainText:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of 14 March 2025 by and between Northwind Systems Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Northwind"), and Calder Analytics Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales ("Calder"). Each party may disclose to the other certain confidential and proprietary information. The receiving party shall hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party for a period of three (3) years from the date of disclosure.

MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made effective 1 January 2026 between Helio Cloud Inc. ("Provider") and Brightline Logistics LLC ("Customer"). Provider shall perform the services described in one or more Statements of Work executed by the parties and incorporated herein. This Agreement governs all such Statements of Work and sets out the general terms applicable to the ongoing provision of services, including fees, term and termination, limitation of liability, and indemnification.

DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") forms part of the agreement between the parties. The Customer is the Controller and the Vendor is the Processor within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 ("GDPR"). The Processor shall process Personal Data only on documented instructions from the Controller, shall ensure that persons authorised to process the Personal Data are bound by confidentiality, and shall implement the technical and organisational measures set out in Annex II. Sub-processors are listed in Annex III and the Controller shall be notified of any intended changes.

SCHEDULE 1

Contractor will design and deliver a data migration from the Customer's legacy warehouse to the new platform. Deliverables: (a) migration plan by 15 April 2026; (b) staged migration of all historical records; (c) post-migration validation report. The engagement is estimated at 240 hours at a blended rate of USD 185 per hour, invoiced monthly in arrears. This Schedule is governed by and incorporated into the Master Services Agreement between the parties dated 1 January 2026.
